title: Error cascade from one missing semicolon
compiler_output:

 int ledPin = 9;
 ^~~

   pinMode(ledPin, OUTPUT);
           ^~~~~~

reference_context.title: GNU C / ld Documentation
reference_context.document: Using the GNU Compiler Collection (GCC): Options to Request or Suppress Warnings
reference_context.section: 3.8 Options to Request or Suppress Warnings: -Wfatal-errors
reference_context.snippet: This option causes the compiler to abort compilation on the first error occurred rather than trying to keep going and printing further error messages.

expected.root_cause: Line 1 is missing a semicolon after `int sensorPin = A0`, so ledPin is never declared and the later errors cascade from it.
expected.fix: Add the semicolon: int sensorPin = A0;
